exposure: Infant formula enriched with galacto-oligosaccharides, beta-palmitate, and acidified milk
cohort: A group of 110 healthy full-term infants (51 in the enriched formula group, 59 in the standard formula group) participated in the study.
finding: The enriched infant formula confirmed safety and growth adequacy, showing a positive effect on neonatal gut microbiota with increased fecal Bifidobacteria counts compared to the standard formula.
